a.lede: Nvidia gets a new chief executive, days after former CEO Jensen Huang admitted to a romantic affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
a.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang resigns, chipmaker names CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO

b.title: Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair
